title: Time-Varying Data as Sheaves: an Invitation to Narratives
abstract: arXiv:2609.09056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern science and engineering increasingly rely on time-varying data, yet the mathematical tools used to model temporal phenomena are often developed within separate disciplines, obscuring common principles and limiting the transfer of ideas across fields. This chapter presents the theory of narratives, an abstract framework for time-varying objects of any mathematical kind that supports both theoretical investigations and applications. To illustrate this perspective, the chapter develops three vignettes, each illustrating a different research direction. The first addresses a general concern: What information loss can occur when switching between different representations of temporal data? The second concerns structural and algorithmic approaches: How can we systematically decompose time-varying data into simple pieces and obtain invariants describing its structural complexity? translated_title: 时变数据的层表示：叙事理论导引
translated_abstract: 现代科学与工程日益依赖时变数据，然而用于建模时间现象的数学工具往往在各独立学科内发展，掩盖了共同原理并限制了跨领域的思想交流。本章介绍了叙事理论，这是一个针对任意数学类型时变对象的抽象框架，既支持理论研究也支持实际应用。为阐明这一视角，本章展开了三个专题，每个专题展示一个不同的研究方向。第一个专题解决一个普遍关注的问题：在时变数据的不同表示之间切换时，会发生怎样的信息损失？第二个专题关注结构与算法方法：如何系统地将时变数据分解为简单的组成部分，并获得描述其结构复杂性的不变量？第三个专题是控制理论中的一个应用：我们如何……
tldr: 本文提出基于层理论的“叙事”抽象框架，为任意数学类型的时变对象提供统一建模方法，并通过表示转换中的信息损失分析、结构分解与不变量构造、以及控制理论应用三个方向展示了该框架的广泛价值。
en_tdlr: This chapter introduces the theory of narratives, an abstract sheaf-theoretic framework for modeling time-varying objects of any mathematical kind, illustrated through three research directions: information loss in switching representations, systematic decomposition with structural invariants, and applications to control theory.
